import datetime
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
TIME_FORMAT = "%d/%m/%y %H:%M:%S.%f"

def task_func(time_strings):
    times = [datetime.datetime.strptime(ts, TIME_FORMAT) for ts in time_strings]
    diffs = np.array(
        [(times[i + 1] - times[i]).total_seconds() for i in range(len(times) - 1)],
        dtype=int
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(np.arange(len(diffs)), diffs)
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Time Difference (seconds)")
    ax.set_title("Time Differences Between Consecutive Datetimes")
    return ax
